breakdown.description: The prompt makes the bending stress uniform through the depth, even though the flexure formula gives a linear stress distribution with zero stress at the neutral axis.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly applies the standard linear bending stress formula σ = M·y / I, explicitly states that the stress at the neutral axis (y = 0) must be 0 MPa, and describes a linear distribution with compressive stress at the top fiber and tensile stress at the bottom fiber. This directly contradicts and corrects the incomplete prompt's erroneous instruction to treat bending stress as uniform over the section depth.
